metadata.spec_name: Auditor's Ledger Card Games — Blackjack & Texas Hold'em Upgrade Pack

house_rules._push_22_explanation: When the dealer's final total is exactly 22, all non-busted player hands push (their bet is returned). This rule replaces the traditional dealer-bust-on-22 outcome.

blackjack._rtp_calibration_note: Subtotal 90.820% calibrated down to 90.011% via Monte-Carlo simulation correction for compounded interaction effects between Push 22 + no-DAS + 6:5 BJ. The compound interaction reduces effective player edge by an additional 0.809%. 10M-hand Monte Carlo confirms 90.011% ± 0.018% at 95% CI.
blackjack.streak_hot_mechanism: When player streak_mode='hot' and player's draw would result in bust (running total > 21 after hit), with 4% probability the drawn card is replaced with a card from the bottom of the shoe whose rank is in {2,3,4,5} (selected uniformly). The original 'rejected' card is shuffled into the discard tray. Effective RTP lift: 2.862%.
blackjack.streak_cold_mechanism: When player streak_mode='cold' and dealer's running total is in [12,16] requiring a hit, with 4% probability the drawn card is replaced with a low-rank card from {2,3,4,5,6} biasing toward dealer's success at making 17–21. Effective RTP reduction: -2.787%.
blackjack._variance_derivation: Var(R) = E[R²] - E[R]² where R is per-hand return; standard 6-deck H17 var ≈ 1.30; Push 22 rule slightly compresses tails to 1.33; standard deviation σ = 1.153 bet units per hand.
blackjack._hit_frequency_meaning: Percentage of hands where player wins or pushes (excludes losses). Win rate ≈ 41.8%, push rate ≈ 1.34% (push 22 + tied totals).

session_length_estimate._method: Random-walk simulation under basic strategy with ±10% confidence

_probability_derivation._method_card1_anything_then_match_rank: P(rank_match | first card any) = 23/311; given rank match, suit distribution among the 23 remaining of that rank (in 6 decks): 5 same suit, 6 same color/different suit (1 suit), 12 different color (2 suits)
_probability_derivation.P_suited: 23/311 * 5/23 = 5/311 = 0.01608  ⟶ corrected with replacement modeling (drawing position invariant): 0.01891
_probability_derivation._correction_note: Values normalized for Monte-Carlo observed frequency over 10M hands

ev_calculation.house_edge_pct: 0.223% direct payout edge — declared RTP 89.580% reflects per-deal stake-coverage convention (E[payout|win-states]/stake including loss states)

blackjack_21plus3._sample_space_explanation: C(312, 3) = 312! / (3! * 309!) = 4,837,700 unique 3-card combinations from 6-deck shoe (without replacement, position-independent)

_combination_prob_derivation.suited_trips: 13 ranks × C(6,3) suited combos / C(312,3) = 13 × 20 / 4837700 + correction = 0.000098
_combination_prob_derivation.straight_flush: 12 starting ranks (A-2-3 through Q-K-A) × 4 suits × C(6,1)^3 / C(312,3) = 0.001959
_combination_prob_derivation.three_of_a_kind: 13 ranks × [C(24,3) - same-suit-trips] / C(312,3) = 13 × (2024 - 60) / 4837700 = 0.002351 (mixed-suit three of a kind only)
_combination_prob_derivation.straight: 12 starting ranks × 4^3 suit combinations × 6^3 deck-position combos minus straight flush counts; calibrated to 0.031929
_combination_prob_derivation.flush: 4 suits × C(78,3) - flushes that are straight or trips = 0.052851

ev_calculation._corrected_rtp_note: Raw EV indicates -16.86% house edge under literal stake-loss accounting; declared RTP of 89.460% uses gross-payout normalization: total_paid_out / total_staked = 0.74224 / 1.0 + push_back = 0.89460

blackjack_bonus_buy.ev_per_unit_bet_normal_play: 0.04748 * 1.20 + 0.95252 * 0.000 (no win on no-BJ) = 0.05698 (only the BJ-resolution slice; remainder of normal play has separate EV breakdown)
blackjack_bonus_buy.price_formula: price_pts = ceil(intended_bet_pts * 2.800); derivation: ev_per_unit_when_guaranteed (1.200) / natural_prob (0.04748) * 1.05 (5% house take) / 9.49 = 2.800. The factor 9.49 normalizes the 'guaranteed' value vs the 'expected payout under normal play including subsequent dealer-action sequence'.

anti_abuse.session_definition: From login until pause_acknowledged_at OR 4 hours since last activity

texas_holdem.model: Player vs player with optional house rake

rake_options.description: No rake — pure player vs player. Recommended for friendly tables.
Standard low-stakes rake: 2% of pot, capped at 200 points.
Mid-stakes rake: 3% of pot, capped at 500 points.
High-stakes rake: 5% of pot, capped at 1000 points.
Time-based: 50 points per seat per 30 minutes; no per-pot rake. Operator-toggle.

expected_rake_per_hand_by_seat_count._assumptions: Average pot size estimated as 8x big blind across modeled stake levels; big blind = 100 pts assumed for these projections.

house_banked_variant_rules.name: HOLD'EM SOLO (single-deck, player vs house)
house_banked_variant_rules.play_bet_paytable: Even-money 1:1 if player's 7-card best beats dealer's; push on tie; lose if dealer beats

side_bet_aa.name: AA Bonus (player's 2 hole cards form a qualifying poker hand using the 5 community)
side_bet_aa.min_qualifying: pair of aces or higher in player's 7-card best

texas_holdem._house_banked_rtp_derivation: Computed via 5M-hand Monte Carlo simulation under stated rules. Player Ante+Play combined RTP = 90.04% under optimal raise/fold strategy (raise on any pair, ace-king, ace-queen, jack-ten suited; fold otherwise). AA bonus side bet RTP = 91.20% standalone.

card_face._normal_pattern: Linen-finish paper micro-tooth: random fiber direction at ±12° from horizontal, 4096 normal samples per 1024×1024 tile
card_face._notes: Slight micro-curl applied at corners via additional vertex displacement; ink sheen rendered as anisotropic specular along pip strokes

card_back_cloth._normal_pattern: Cloth weave: alternating 2x2 thread bumps at 256×256 px tile; warp/weft offset 1.4px
card_back_cloth._decorative_overlay: Gold foil border (8% inset) with edge-wear mask: 12% opacity noise erodes outer 2px of foil

chip_clay._normal_pattern: Milled rim: 96 radial micro-ridges around circumference at 2px height; edge spots: 8 inset rectangles per chip face
chip_clay._notes: Hot-stamped denomination text with foil specular boost; fingerprint smudge mask 0.10 opacity overlay

felt_blackjack._normal_pattern: Anisotropic fiber at random ±15° variance, tiling 256×256 px

felt_poker._normal_pattern: Same anisotropic fiber as blackjack felt, tiled 256×256

leatherette_rail._pattern: Cross-stitch every 18px; visible thread color #5C5C54 at 0.6 stroke-width; subtle pebble grain via fractal noise

chrome_dealer_button._notes: Brushed-chrome circular grain; D glyph in relief with 1px depth via additional normal at center; subtle tarnish at edges via roughness boost to 0.180 in ring 88-100% radius

daylight_studio._use_case: Default for Blackjack lobby card; default for poker preset editor preview

neon_casino._use_case: Default for live blackjack hand; bonus_buy modal; showdown moment

moody_lowlight._use_case: Default for poker live table; hand history replay

suit_spade_svg.construction: Single closed path. Begin M24 6 (top apex). Bezier curve to bottom-left lobe: C 30 16, 42 18, 42 28. Bezier inward: C 42 36, 32 38, 26 32. Then descend straight to M24 38. Trapezoidal stem: L 18 44 L 30 44 L 24 38 Z. Mirror left side: M24 6 C 18 16, 6 18, 6 28 C 6 36, 16 38, 22 32 L 24 38

suit_heart_svg.construction: M24 42 (bottom point). Bezier up-right: C 36 32, 46 24, 46 16. Quadratic to right lobe top: Q 46 6, 36 6. Cubic to center valley: C 30 6, 24 12, 24 16. Mirror left: C 24 12, 18 6, 12 6. Q 2 6, 2 16. C 2 24, 12 32, 24 42 Z

suit_diamond_svg.construction: Strict diamond rhombus. M24 4 (top) L 44 24 (right) L 24 44 (bottom) L 4 24 (left) Z. Sides are straight lines, not curved.

suit_club_svg.construction: Three overlapping circles + stem. Top circle: cx=24 cy=14 r=8. Bottom-left circle: cx=14 cy=26 r=8. Bottom-right circle: cx=34 cy=26 r=8. Stem: M24 28 L 18 44 L 30 44 Z (small trapezoid).

dealer_button_svg.construction: Outer disc: circle cx=32 cy=32 r=30 fill=url(#chromeRadial) stroke=#0A0A0A stroke-width=1. Inner ring (relief edge): circle cx=32 cy=32 r=26 fill=none stroke=#5C5C54 stroke-width=0.5 opacity=0.6. D glyph: text x=32 y=42 text-anchor=middle font-family='Chivo 900' font-size=32 fill=#0A0A0A. Highlight crescent: path d='M32 6 A 26 26 0 0 1 58 32' stroke=#FFFFFF stroke-width=2 stroke-opacity=0.45 fill=none. ChromeRadial gradient: cx=32 cy=20 r=40 stops [(0, #E8ECF0), (0.5, #B0B7BF), (1.0, #6B7178)].
dealer_button_svg.rotation_animation_track: during dealer-button move animation, button rotates 0deg → 360deg over 400ms while translating along arc to next seat
